jobs.description:
For our client in the Veurne region, we are looking for a SOLAR PANEL TECHNICIAN.

Our client is a well-established company with years of experience in providing sustainable energy solutions. With a strong passion for technology and technical installations, they are committed to helping build a greener future. Would you like to contribute to the transition towards renewable energy in Belgium and neighboring countries? Then keep reading!

As a SOLAR PANEL TECHNICIAN in the Veurne region, your responsibilities will include:

  • Connecting solar panel installations, home battery systems, and/or EV charging stations;
  • Installing the inverter and providing the required AC and DC cabling according to industry standards;
  • Connecting the AC and DC cables to the inverter;
  • Making any necessary modifications to the electrical distribution board;
  • Completing the single-line electrical diagram to ensure the technical inspection can be carried out;
  • Commissioning the complete installation and providing the customer with clear instructions and explanations on its operation.

As a SOLAR PANEL TECHNICIAN, you recognize yourself in the following profile:

  • You hold a valid Category B driving licence;
  • You have a strong electrical background (experience with solar panels is an advantage but can be taught);
  • You are able to read and interpret technical drawings with ease;
  • You speak Dutch or English;
  • You have a strong focus on safety and always follow the correct procedures and regulations.

For our client located in DIKSMUIDE, we are looking for a CNC SETTER.

Our client is a technical and innovative company active in the manufacturing industry. They offer a family-oriented working environment and are committed to investing in both technology and their employees.

As a CNC SETTER in the DIKSMUIDE region, you will be responsible for the following tasks:

  • Setting up and programming CNC machines (mainly 3-axis lathes);
  • Producing unique pieces based on technical drawings (limited series production);
  • Setting up and programming CNC machines;
  • Reading and interpreting technical drawings prepared by the engineering department;
  • Measuring finished parts and comparing them with the technical drawings;
  • Checking the quality of the manufactured parts;
  • Working mainly with 3-axis lathes.

As a CNC SETTER in the DIKSMUIDE region, you can identify yourself with the following:

  • You have experience setting up CNC-controlled machines;
  • You have a good understanding of reading technical drawings, machining techniques, measurement techniques, and determining tolerances;
  • You can operate an overhead crane or are willing to learn this internally;
  • You speak Dutch or English.

For our client located in DIKSMUIDE, we are looking for a MECHANICAL ASSEMBLER FIELD.

Our client is a well-known company active in water pumps and water treatment. They are a close-knit team where employees are always the number one priority.

As a MECHANICAL ASSEMBLER FIELD in the DIKSMUIDE region, you will perform the following tasks:

  • Installing and assembling screw pumps, water treatment installations, bridges, and other structures on-site;
  • Ensuring the commissioning of these installations or carrying out maintenance work;
  • Performing necessary repairs and renovation works when required;
  • Working mainly in Belgium, with occasional assignments in the Netherlands, France, and Germany;
  • Staying overnight in hotels when required;
  • Working with various welding machines and, when necessary, operating equipment such as overhead cranes and aerial work platforms.
As a MECHANICAL ASSEMBLER FIELD in the DIKSMUIDE region, you can identify yourself with the following:

  • You have a technically oriented diploma with knowledge of welding techniques;
  • You are willing to occasionally stay overnight in a hotel, as the projects are carried out on different locations;
  • You are not afraid of outdoor work and large constructions;
  • You have a good understanding of reading technical drawings and using various assembly techniques and equipment;
  • You are able to work independently and take initiative;
  • You have a driving licence B;
  • You speak Dutch or English.

For our client located in DIKSMUIDE, we are looking for a CONSTRUCTION WELDER FIELD.

Our client is a well-known company active in water pumps and water treatment. They are a close-knit team where employees are always the number one priority.

As a CONSTRUCTION WELDER FIELD in the DIKSMUIDE region, you will perform the following tasks:

  • Assembling and welding steel structures such as screws, water treatment installations, and other constructions;
  • Building structures according to assembly plans and guidelines;
  • Using various welding techniques: TIG, MIG, and electrode welding;
  • Checking dimensions, shapes, weld seams, and overall quality;
  • Adjusting parts where necessary in case of deformations or defects;
  • Working with different welding machines and, when required, operating equipment such as overhead cranes and aerial work platforms.
As a CONSTRUCTION WELDER FIELD in the DIKSMUIDE region, you can identify yourself with the following:

  • You have experience or a diploma as a welder, with knowledge of various welding techniques;
  • You possess all required certificates (mandatory);
  • You have a good understanding of reading technical drawings and using various assembly techniques and equipment;
  • You are able to work independently, are allowed to do so, and take initiative;
  • You have basic knowledge of electrical systems and hydraulics;
  • You have a driving licence B;
  • You speak Dutch or English.

For our client in the ICHTEGEM region, we are looking for a CE TIPPER TRUCK DRIVER.

Our client is a family-owned company specialized in bulk transport, concrete transport, tipper truck transport and traction transport.

As a CE TIPPER TRUCK DRIVER in ICHTEGEM, you will be responsible for the following tasks:

  • Delivering soil and waste materials from earthworks using a tipper truck;
  • Transporting and delivering materials in accordance with safety regulations and applicable instructions;
  • Cleaning the truck;
  • Communicating with customers in a friendly and professional manner;
  • Unloading the truck at construction sites and driving back to reload.
As a CE DRIVER in NIEUWPOORT, you can identify with the following:

  • Experience as a CE DRIVER;
  • You are in possession of a CE driving licence, a valid Code 95 and a driver card;
  • You speak Dutch OR English OR French.

Are you an experienced asphalt worker who enjoys rolling up your sleeves?

To strengthen our team, we are looking for an experienced asphalt worker to join our asphalt crew.

What does your job involve?

  • You assist the asphalt crew with the preparation, laying and finishing of hot-mix asphalt;
  • You help ensure the correct distribution and finishing of the asphalt;
  • You are responsible for touching up and finishing asphalt around joints and connections;
  • You help create a smooth and high-quality road surface;
  • You work closely with machine operators, roller operators, drivers and other colleagues on site;
  • You work with modern machinery, techniques and tools;
  • You depart daily from Oostende.
What do we expect from you?

  • You have experience in asphalt works, preferably as an asphalt worker;
  • You have knowledge of the different steps involved in laying and finishing hot-mix asphalt;
  • You are physically fit and enjoy active, hands-on work;
  • You are flexible and have no problem working in different weather conditions;
  • You speak fluent Dutch or English;
  • You are able to get to our depot in Oostende independently every day.

For the strengthening of our team, we are looking for a truck driver with a Category C driving licence to operate our emulsion truck.

You will depart from our depot in Oostende and drive to various construction sites throughout West Flanders. In addition to the transport, you will also be responsible for the correct application and processing of the emulsion on site, meaning you will be active both behind the wheel and on the construction site.

Your responsibilities:

  • You transport emulsion from our depot in Oostende to various construction sites throughout West Flanders;
  • You are responsible for the correct and safe loading and unloading of emulsion;
  • You operate the emulsion truck's equipment and ensure the correct application of the emulsion;
  • You work both with machinery and manually during the processing of emulsion on site.



What do we expect from you?

  • You have a valid Category C driving licence.
  • Code 95 is NOT required.
  • You have good technical insight and are willing to learn how the emulsion truck operates and how emulsion is processed on site.
  • You speak and understand sufficient Dutch or English to communicate safely and smoothly with your colleagues.

Would you like to help build high-quality roads throughout West Flanders? Then we would love to hear from you!

jobs.occupation: Account Receivable & Credit Officer - Brussels - Food Sector
jobs.description:
Our client is looking for a Credit & AR Officer to support his financial administration team. Reporting to the Credit & Account Receivable Manager, you are responsible for the coordination of our account receivable flow.

Client Details

Our client is a family-founded multinational company, leader in the global packaged goods industry, known for producing high-quality consumer products. Originating in Europe, the company has expanded its footprint to over a hundred countries, maintaining a strong presence in both mature and emerging markets.

Description

• Verification and recording of accounts receivable data
• Processing of incoming payments
• Compliance with group financial policies and procedures
• Preparation of invoices 
• Management of bank deposits
• Following up with clients to facilitate invoice payments
• Regular communication with clients
• Financial data analysis and report creation
• Monitoring credit-related performance indicators (KPIs)
• Implementation of action plans to ensure the company's financial health

• Minimum 3 years of experience as an A/R Officer or in a similar role
• Trilingual proficiency in Dutch, French, and English, enabling effective communication with diverse stakeholders
• High accuracy and attention to detail in work, especially in record-keeping
• Strong critical thinking skills to support precise and efficient operations
• Proficient in Excel and SAP, with hands-on technical knowledge
• Proactive problem-solver, addressing technical challenges with practical solutions
• Solid experience in credit collection and understanding of its accounting complexities
• Valuable contributor to effective management of accounts receivables

For an international logistics organization we are looking for a Junior Accountant. This role exists to support accurate accounting, monthly closing, reporting, and audit processes. You will work in a collaborative, multicultural finance team with open communication and opportunities to learn. We are seeking a precise, proactive professional who is comfortable working with figures and asking questions.

Your responsibilities

• 
Process invoices, journal entries, bank bookings, and expense claims in SAP.

• 
Review transactions, investigate discrepancies, and monitor DMS workflows.

• 
Support monthly closing, reconciliations, account checks, and overdue follow-up.

• 
Prepare audit and J-SOX documentation.

• 
Assist colleagues with accounting questions and process improvements.

• 
Provide backup support for reporting and other finance activities.

Your profile

• 
Graduate or Bachelor’s degree in accounting or a related field.

• 
Approximately 2–3 years of relevant accounting experience.

• 
Knowledge of Belgian accounting principles.

• 
Experience with SAP; DMS knowledge is an advantage.

• 
Accurate, analytical, organized, and proactive.

• 
Fluent in English.

Our client specializes in sustainable insulation materials and provides customers with a complete insulation solution.

Jobomschrijving

As a Junior Blowerdoor Technician, you will be responsible for carrying out airtightness tests on a wide range of construction projects. This role combines technical fieldwork with customer interaction and technical advisory services. 

Your responsibilities: 

• Performing blower door tests at residential homes, apartment buildings, retail stores, and other construction projects. 
• Using specialized testing equipment to measure the airtightness of buildings and identify air leakage. 
• Interpreting test results and preparing clear, accurate technical reports. 
• Explaining the results to customers and providing technical advice on potential improvements to enhance a building's airtightness. 
• Working independently on-site while ensuring a high-quality, accurate and customer-focused execution of all measurements. 
• Building and maintaining professional relationships with customers and acting as their technical point of contact throughout the testing process. 

The ideal Junior Blowerdoor Technician: 

• A junior profile with a technical background, preferably a Bachelor's degree in Construction or another relevant technical field. 
• Previous experience with blower door testing is not required. Motivation and willingness to learn are far more important. 
• A strong interest in engineering, construction, and building technologies, combined with a proactive, independent, and responsible mindset. 
• Good communication skills in French, with added knowledge of Dutch and/or English.
• A flexible attitude, including the willingness to start early, work occasional evenings, and weekends. 
• Based in the Brussels or Flemish Brabant region, with the willingness to travel to construction sites throughout Belgium.

Our client is an international leader in the life sciences industry, based in Zaventem. They offer a long-term opportunity within their Customer Service team, providing a dynamic international environment, comprehensive training, and strong career development prospects.

Jobomschrijving

As a Customer Service, your key responsibilities are:

• Processing and managing customer purchase orders in a timely manner, ensuring compliance with customer logistics and shipping requirements.
• Serve as the first point of contact for customers, handling inquiries and resolving day-to-day issues.
• Provide customers with accurate information regarding orders, products, and services while adhering to company processes and procedures.
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders to manage escalations and ensure prompt resolution of customer concerns.
• Register and track customer issues within Salesforce and ensure appropriate follow-up actions are taken.
• Coordinate closely with Logistics and Warehouse teams to resolve order and delivery-related issues efficiently.
• Support knowledge sharing and participate in market-specific training initiatives.
• Contribute to team performance by maintaining a customer-focused mindset, supporting colleagues, and working towards established KPIs.

We are looking for:

• Previous experience in Customer Service, Order Management, or a related sales administrative role.
• Strong communication and problem-solving skills with a customer-centric approach.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, international environment.
• Fluent in English and Spanish, with a good command of Portuguese.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office applications. Experience with ERP systems is a plus.

Our client is a production company.

Jobomschrijving

• Assist in the period-end closing process, ensuring integrity and accuracy of financial statements.
• Partner with other departments to align financial control activities with strategic objectives.
• Assist the team members and provide qualitative financial support.
• Assist the team in improving financial end to end processes.

jobs.occupation: Registered Nurse at the U.S. Embassy in Belgium
jobs.description:
The U.S. Mission in Belgium is seeking eligible and qualified applicants for the position of Registered Nurse in the Health Unit.

Jobomschrijving

The jobholder serves as the post’s nurse with responsibilities that include the medical care of Mission employees and eligible family members, utilizing MED approved clinical guidelines, as well as maintenance and inventory of all medical equipment and supplies, implementation of a robust vaccination program, documentation through the global electronic medical record, system administration of group and individual health education programs, and medical emergency contingency planning for the Mission.

EDUCATION: Degree in Nursing (RN level) or Diploma/Certificate equivalent.
EXPERIENCE: 2 years post-qualification clinical work as a professional nurse within the last 10 years.
LANGUAGE: Good working knowledge in English.

The job holder carries out scheduled and unscheduled electrical preventive maintenance and repair work to all mission buildings and facilities including residential owned and leased properties.
 
EDUCATION: Secondary school diploma + vocational training.

EXPERIENCE: 3 years of experience in the repair and maintenance of electrical systems

LANGUAGE: Working knowledge English. Good working knowledge in French or Dutch.

DRIVER'S LICENSE B
 
Dynamic and multi-cultural work environment.

Full-time position with extra-legal benefits: life insurance, hospitalization insurance (family included), meal tickets, transportation reimbursements, seniority leave, special holidays, training, Employee Assistance Program, etc.

Salary as of €4.158 gross/month.
